_doc: Intent concepts for the SOFT scene check (pipeline/story/intent.py). `words`: story text that suggests it (scene title, line, `intent`); `tags`/`biomes`/`media`/`treats`: what a scene setup can use to deliver it; `expect`: minimum fraction of the rendered frame that should look like it (colour classes from pipeline/story/intent.py: water snow foliage sand fire). Advisory only: silence per scene with "intent": "none" or "allow": ["ocean"].

ocean.hint: loc ocean_world (surface), loc seabed or biome flooded (underwater)

ice.hint: loc ice_world, or biome frozen / snowy on any world

desert.hint: biome desert on any world (e.g. sky_island, town_square)
